subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 3/4] exportfs: Display and document riomode= and wiomode=

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch updates the exportfs utility to display and document the riomode= and wiomode= options in its verbose output. It also adds warnings when exporting if the running kernel or no-netlink is set, meaning these options will be ignored. The changes include adding new fields to the nfs_export structure, modifying the validate_iomode function, and updating the dump function to display the I/O modes.
